question: Which unresolved product-tariff route questions need a missing package bridge, which can be settled from recorded family exclusions, and which package-route fields have the greatest bounded acquisition value?
prior_information: Original exact/coarse/formulation and robustness marginals known; new information-value counts and masked-reveal outcomes not computed
population: All 564 candidate pairs and 999 linked SL paths in frozen June sources
route_target: Recorded exact-route compatibility; preserve existing explicit-route decisions
scope: Finite documentary possibilities under the modeled vocabulary. OTHER prevents a closed-world assertion that listed family members exhaust real routes. Unknown tariff tokens keep nonoverlap undetermined.
new_decision: Known routes: existing overlap decision. No known routes: certain V if every modeled possibility allowed; certain C if all possibilities excluded and tariff vocabulary complete; otherwise U.
review_value: For each missing-route SL record, reveal each feasible singleton route, propagate it through every retained candidate path, and count U-to-V/C transitions. Report min and max over possibilities; no probability or expected benefit.
ranking: Descending minimum gain, maximum gain, affected unresolved pairs, then source-record ID. Single-field values are not additive.
masked_evaluation: Exhaust every SL record with an explicit parenteral route in the original exact-policy population. Hide that record route only, retain its family and all other facts. Compute prediction and interval before revealing archived route(s). Compare actual determinate-pair gain with frozen bounds and account for each case.
transfer: Report all observed ATC level-2 prefixes (first three characters) for the masked parenteral records; no class selected by favorable results. Each mask trial shares the source population, so counts are not independent clinical observations.
external_reference: Existing glossary/EDQM supports route meanings; no EMA-to-Swiss authorization substitution or imputed route. External document retrieval is a separate possible acquisition step.
comparators: Independent SQLite expression for all uncertainty decisions; finite exhaustive controls; complete source accounting.
outputs: Unresolved-cause census, single-record acquisition bounds and ranking, all masked reveal trials and class summaries, set equality and conservation checks
